card.name: Punctuation inside heart-problem symptom lists
card.fires_on: Commas, 'as' and 'or' inside the stimulant warning list 'signs of heart problems such as chest pain, shortness of breath, or fainting'. It also fires weakly on a few other warning-list joints, such as 'Hep|atic adenomas'.

modes.label: Heart symptom list joints
modes.description: Comma, 'such as' or 'or' within the list of chest pain, shortness of breath and fainting.
modes.example: Call your doctor right away if you or your child has any signs of heart problems such as chest pain<<,>> shortness of breath, or fainting

modes.label: Liver contraindication lists
modes.description: Joints inside lists of liver conditions, such as 'Hep' before 'atic adenomas' or 'including' after active liver disease.
modes.example: Fenofibrate is contraindicated in patients with active liver disease,<< including>> those with primary biliary cirrhosis

card.plain: It marks the commas and linking words in a warning list of symptoms, mainly chest pain, shortness of breath or fainting.
